remarks: Stunning NYC-Style Loft in Historic Clocktower Close. Inclusive of your own indoor garage parking spot (oversized) along with 2 outdoor spots. This Beautifully updated, spacious loft condo offers the perfect blend of modern living and historic charm. Located in the highly sought-after, renovated Hat Factory known as Clocktower Close, the unit features soaring 14' to 16' ceilings, expansive two-story windows, and original exposed wood beams that give it a warm, industrial feel. The stunning brick wall adds character and elegance to the space. The open-concept kitchen and dining area has been meticulously updated with quartz countertops, a subway tile backsplash, and new stainless steel appliances. A half-bath is conveniently located on the main level, while the private bedroom suite upstairs with recessed lighting offers a peaceful retreat.  Residents enjoy access to a range of amenities, including a newly renovated fitness center with sauna, a community room, game lounge, conference room, and landscaped courtyard. A laundry room is conveniently located on the first floor. Location can't be beat! You'll be just minutes from downtown South Norwalk, the Sono Mall, top restaurants, Norwalk beaches, and easy access to the train station, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway. EXCELLENT CREDIT REQUIRED. Move-in/move-out refundable deposit of $250, two-month security deposit, and liability/insurance required.
